title.rendered: Board of Directors Special Meeting – February 28, 2024

content.rendered:
The Sherwood School District Board of Directors will be holding a special meeting on Wednesday, February 28, 2024 at the District Office Board Room (21920 SW Sherwood Blvd) for the purpose of selecting a search firm to lead the executive search for the Superintendent vacancy; the agenda for this meeting can be found here.

  • 6:00pm – Special Meeting (public meeting)

All meetings of the Board of Directors can also be viewed live at the District’s YouTube channel at https://bit.ly/39VlhD3.

Public comment for this meeting can be provided via in-person attendance or via online submission, up to three minutes in length. For in-person public comment, sign up is required and must be completed by 15 minutes prior to the meeting start time. Please arrive at the District Office Board Room no later than 5:45pm to sign up for in-person public comment. 

To electronically submit written public comment for this meeting, please complete the form here. Electronic submission of public comment will be accepted until 3pm on Wednesday, February 28, 2024.  During the meeting, all electronically submitted public comment will be read aloud by the Board Secretary, up to three minutes in length per comment.  Please note that members of the public may submit their comments in-person OR via online submission, but not both. Written comments submitted by those who have already spoken in person during the meeting will not be read aloud. Anonymous comments submitted online will not be read aloud. 

The purpose of public comment is for members of our Board of Directors to hear public concerns, comments, and opinions.  Board members will not respond to submitted public comment. For this meeting, please submit only public comment related to Action Item 3A. To provide public comment on non-agenda topics, please watch for the March 20, 2024 regular business meeting agenda.
